papers.title: Multilevel Monte Carlo Finite Element Method for A Stochastic Optimal Control Problem
papers.abstract: In this paper, we consider the implementation of multi-level Monte Carlo method to a stochastic optimal control problem with log-normal coefficients and its surrogate model problem. From the perspective of two optimization problems, i.e., minimizing the accuracy using a fixed computational cost and minimizing the total computational cost to attain a given accuracy, we derive formulas to determine the optimal sample sizes for each level of multi-level Monte Carlo method. Furthermore, we put forward the multi-level Monte Carlo algorithm for our stochastic optimal control problem and some tricks to deal with the multi-level log-normal coefficients. Finally, we present the numerical results of both the elliptic SPDEs and our control problem to validate the effectiveness over the traditional Monte Carlo method.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多层蒙特卡罗方法可应用于生物力学领域的昂贵仿真不确定性量化，提高采样效率。
llm.why_not_core: No surrogate modeling, no constraints handling, and no biomechanics/implant application.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低随机最优控制问题求解的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 利用多层蒙特卡罗方法结合最优样本量分配进行高效计算
summary_zh.result: 数值验证表明该方法优于传统蒙特卡罗方法

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of solving stochastic optimal control problems with log-normal coefficients.
summary_en.method: A multilevel Monte Carlo finite element method is implemented with optimal sample sizes derived for each level.
summary_en.result: Numerical results on both elliptic SPDEs and the control problem demonstrate improved efficiency over standard Monte Carlo.
summary_en.validation: Validated via numerical benchmarks on elliptic SPDEs and a stochastic optimal control problem.

papers.title: Anterior approach for total hip arthroplasty conversion of hip fusion

corresponding_authors.name: Caroline Scemama
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Reconstructive and Orthopaedic Surgery, Raymond Poincaré Hospital (AP-HP), Garches, France. scemamacaroline@gmail.com

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向（髋关节植入物与股骨柄力学）无关，仅讨论手术入路转换。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve any biomechanical modeling, stress shielding analysis, micromotion quantification, or finite element validation; it is a purely clinical surgical technique report.

summary_zh.motivation: 介绍前入路转换髋关节融合术的技术与结果。
summary_zh.method: 描述手术步骤及临床病例系列。
summary_zh.result: 该入路可有效转换融合髋，并发症率可接受。
summary_zh.validation: 临床病例系列（无对照组）。

summary_en.motivation: To describe the technique and outcomes of converting a hip fusion to total hip arthroplasty via an anterior approach.
summary_en.method: A case series of patients undergoing the conversion surgery with detailed surgical technique.
summary_en.result: The anterior approach effectively converts fused hips with acceptable complication rates.
summary_en.validation: Clinical case series without control group.
